text_en: To the leader. Of the Korahites. A Psalm.
text_cn: 科辣黑后裔歌，用高音，交与乐官。

text_en: Hear this, all you peoples; give ear, all inhabitants of the world,
text_cn: 关于这事，请万民都要静听， 普世居民，请你们侧耳细听，

text_en: both low and high, rich and poor together.
text_cn: 不论贫富无分缙（jìn）绅（shēn）百姓， 请你们都一一侧耳聆听。

text_en: My mouth shall speak wisdom; the meditation of my heart shall be understanding.
text_cn: 我的口要宣讲智慧， 我的心要思念哲理。

text_en: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will solve my riddle to the music of the harp.
text_cn: 我要侧耳恭听谚语， 我要鼓琴解释隐语。

text_en: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when the iniquity of my persecutors surrounds me,
text_cn: 当陷害我者的毒谋围困我时， 在我困厄的日期，我有何所惧？

text_en: those who trust in their wealth and boast of the abundance of their riches?
text_cn: 因为他们只知依恃财产的富足， 他们只会夸耀自己金钱的丰裕；

text_en: Truly, no ransom avails for one’s life, there is no price one can give to God for it.
text_cn: 但是金钱不能使任何人得救， 决不能把人的赎价还给天主，

text_en: For the ransom of life is costly, and can never suffice,
text_cn: 因为人命的赎价非常昂贵， 任何金钱也决不足以赎回，

text_en: that one should live on forever and never see the grave.
text_cn: 不能使人生存久长， 不能使人不见死亡。

text_en: When we look at the wise, they die; fool and dolt perish together and leave their wealth to others.
text_cn: 你看，智者死去，愚昧者也同样沉沦， 他们都将自己的财产遗留给别人。

text_en: Their graves are their homes forever, their dwelling places to all generations, though they named lands their own.
text_cn: 他们虽然曾以自己的名号，给一些地方命名， 但是他们永久的住宅，万代的居所却是坟茔。

text_en: Mortals cannot abide in their pomp; they are like the animals that perish.
text_cn: 人在富贵中绝不能久长， 将与牲畜无异，同样死亡。

text_en: Such is the fate of the foolhardy, the end of those who are pleased with their lot. Selah
text_cn: 这就是自满昏愚者的终途， 这就是自夸幸运者的末路。 (休止)

text_en: Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd; straight to the grave they descend, and their form shall waste away; Sheol shall be their home.
text_cn: 他们就如羊群一般被人赶入深坑， 死亡要牧放他们，义人要主宰他们。 他们的容貌即刻色衰， 阴间将是他们的住宅。

text_en: But God will ransom my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah
text_cn: 但是天主必救我灵脱离阴府，因为他要把我接走。 （休止）

text_en: Do not be afraid when some become rich, when the wealth of their houses increases.
text_cn: 不要嫉妒他人变成富翁， 不要忌恨他人家产倍增；

text_en: For when they die they will carry nothing away; their wealth will not go down after them.
text_cn: 因为他死时什么也不能带走， 他的财产也不能随着他同去。

text_en: Though in their lifetime they count themselves happy —for you are praised when you do well for yourself—
text_cn: 他在生时虽自我陶醉说： “只要你幸福，人必夸赞你。”

text_en: they will go to the company of their ancestors, who will never again see the light.
text_cn: 他终要回去和他的祖先相逢， 永永远远他再不能看到光明。

text_en: Mortals cannot abide in their pomp; they are like the animals that perish.
text_cn: 人在富贵中，不深思远虑， 将与牲畜无异，都要死去。
